title: Equipment catalog document
description: Shape of presets/<mode>/equipment.json. Loaded by presets.loadEquipmentPreset / getEquipmentItem. Storage: catalog document (items[]).

customSpriteGenre.description: Optional catalog genre for Custom Sprite when different from the mode genre (e.g. steampunk while editing a standard-mode item). Empty = mode genre. Controls the catalog list and wiki/runtime sprite path for customSprite.

customSprite.description: Optional genre equipment catalog id used for art when this combat item has no matching sprite under its own id. Designer: Select opens the equipment art catalog filtered by customSpriteGenre (or mode genre). Alpha thumb preview in wiki and form.

slot.description: Equipment slot. Relation filters on player profiles use these strings. Empty = unset (omit on disk). Potions / runes / currency usually have no slot.

category.description: Item family. Combat + loot-only (currency / gem / food / potion / rune / tool). tool is backpack-only; not a hand slot.

weaponType.description: Weapon family for power curves. Empty = unset (omit on disk). Armor / potions / currency must not invent melee.

type.description: Pipeline type tags (potion, consumable, container, …). Distinct from category.

vocation.description: Allowed class vocations (same ids as classes / spells.vocations).

level.description: Minimum character level to equip or use.

heal.description: On-use HP restore [min, max]. Catalog is source of truth (e.g. small_health_potion [60, 90]).

restoreMana.description: On-use mana restore [min, max]. Catalog is source of truth (e.g. mana_potion [75, 125]).

worth.description: Currency value in gold units (gold_coin = 1, platinum_coin = 100).

imbuementSlots.description: Number of imbuement slots on this item.

consumable.description: When true, use consumes one stack unit (potions, food).

usable.description: When true, the item can be used from the backpack (potions).

hitChance.description: Distance-weapon hit-chance modifier added to ammo/throw maxHitChance (e.g. amber_bow +6 → 91 becomes 97). Not an absolute percent on bows. Live values may be outside 0–100.

perfectShotDamage.description: Bonus damage when the target is at perfectShotRange.

perfectShotRange.description: Chebyshev range at which perfectShotDamage applies.

twoHanded.description: True if the weapon requires both hands to be wielded (e.g. bows, crossbows, some swords/axes/clubs).

extraAtk.description: Second attack value on dual-element weapons (fire sword extra 11). Combined with atk for the auto formula, then split by extraAtk/(atk+extraAtk). Physical share uses armor+block; extra share uses extraAtkElement resist only.

extraAtkElement.description: Element of extraAtk on dual-element weapons. Required with extraAtk for the split. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

defenseBonus.description: Weapon extradef / defense modifier. Applied to total defense only when a shield contributes defense > 0.

stackable.description: When true, identical itemId instances merge into one container slot with count (weight = unit × count). Max stack size is 100. Used for arrows/bolts, throwing weapons (spears/stars), and runes (category rune). Omit when false.

breakChance.description: Throwing weapons only: percent chance (0–100) to destroy one stack unit on each throw (hit or miss). 100 = always consume one. Cap weight uses unit × remaining count.

ammoType.description: Required for category ammo: which distance weapon may fire this stack. Bows consume arrow; crossbows consume bolt. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

autoShape.description: When distance_auto spends this ammo, resolve as a shaped auto centered on the sticky target. Crit is multiply-only; one crit roll per swing. Omit on ST ammo.

tier.description: Weapon classification rank. Fatal chance = 0.05 t² + 0.4 t + 0.05 percent when t > 0. Omit or 0 = never. No standard rows ship a tier.

min.description: Wand/rod auto-attack damage floor (legacy fromDamage). Omit on other items.

max.description: Wand/rod auto-attack damage ceiling (legacy toDamage). Omit on other items.

element.description: Wand/rod auto-attack element (legacy wandType). Empty = unset (omit on disk).

manaGain.description: Mana restored on a wand/rod auto that deals final damage > 0 after reductions. Authored from wand level; not computed at runtime.

durationSec.description: Temporary item lifetime in seconds (data-only until tick/decay stage).

spriteId.description: Alias of customSprite (equipment picker historically reads spriteId).

maxHitChance.description: Ammo or throwing-weapon hit-chance cap (percent). Distance auto rolls min(100, maxHitChance + equipped weapon hitChance). Live arrows/bolts are ~76–100. Omit when not ammo/throw.

critChance.description: Additive crit chance. Catalog pipeline units: 1000 = +10%. Stacks with class/profile percent. Runtime roll is 0–100. Omit when none.

critExtraDamage.description: Additive extra crit damage. Catalog pipeline units: 3500 = +35%. Stacks with class/profile critDamage percent. Omit when none.

lifeLeechChance.description: Life-leech proc chance 0–100 (100 = always). Additive across equipped items. Omit when none.

lifeLeechAmount.description: Life-leech amount. Catalog pipeline units: 1800 = 18% of real HP damage on proc. Additive. Omit when none.

manaLeechChance.description: Mana-leech proc chance 0–100 (100 = always). Additive across equipped items. Omit when none.

manaLeechAmount.description: Mana-leech amount. Catalog pipeline units: 300 = 3% of real HP damage on proc. Additive. Omit when none.

aliases.description: Alternate ids that resolve to this row.

dispel.description: Condition kinds this item removes on use. Catalog is source of truth (e.g. poison on antidote_potion).

condition.description: On-use condition applied via applyCondition. Catalog is source of truth (e.g. magic_shield_potion mana_shield). Same shape as spell.condition.
